tasks.label: Run Group: Linters and type Checking
tasks.detail: Runs both Ruff (with --fix) and MyPy to automatically fix lint issues and check type safety for the codebase.

tasks.label: MyPy: Run Type Checking
tasks.detail: Runs MyPy to perform static type checking on the ./snappylapy package.

tasks.label: Pytest+Coverage: Show .html pytest coverage report from last test run
tasks.detail: Opens the HTML coverage report generated by pytest in the default browser.

tasks.label: Pytest: Run Unit Tests
tasks.detail: Runs pytest for unit tests (excluding integration tests) with coverage and generates an HTML report.

tasks.label: ruff: Run Ruff check
tasks.detail: Runs Ruff static code analysis to check for linting issues in the ./snappylapy package.

tasks.label: ruff: Run Ruff fix
tasks.detail: Runs Ruff static code analysis with --fix to automatically fix linting issues in the ./snappylapy package.
